name: annolens
description: Evidence-driven gene-model curation: review, repair, split and add gene models from transcripts, proteins and reads.

interface.longDescription: An agent reviews evidence images and read checks, then repairs truncated, split or fused gene models and adds missing genes; every change is validated by the engine.
defaultPrompt: Check whether this gene model is right
Is a gene missing at this locus?
Review the first 20 genes of the queue and summarise
